author: RifRifRif8
body: Despite the Villa market store and products are at top level, but their app is just pure disaster, i have never experienced anything worse as this app. It’s getting worse with every update, you can’t select properly, can’t search properly, you can’t press the buttons, it all does not work. Fire you dev team completely and get a new one, download some other apps to see how things should and can work. It’s 2026, it’s unacceptable to have app like this, it’s just kills all your user experience. I am super loyal to Villa Market but I am about to quit for ever.
suggested_reply: Sorry the app has been this broken — especially when the stores and products are good. Broken selection, search, and unresponsive buttons after updates are on us. Your review is with the iOS team.

author: Hugh Musbekidding
body: Latest release takes forever to open. Stopped using at shopping till - faster to just give my phone number.
suggested_reply: Sorry the latest release takes forever to open — so long you gave up at the till. Slow/hung launch after update is a known issue we're chasing on Android. Thanks for spelling out the impact.

author: S De Silva
body: Not compatible with Android Developer Mode? There are no security issues tied to this mode, all Thai banks support it. If you're developer says otherwise, get another developer.
suggested_reply: Agreed — Developer Mode isn't a security threat here, and Thai banks allow it. Blocking the app for that is on us. We've pushed the Android team to drop this restriction.

author: Stoh Nick
body: A waste of my time. It tells me the entire store is out of stock on juice. Any and all kinds of juice are out of stock. that's not true.
suggested_reply: Sorry the app claimed every juice in the store was out of stock when it wasn't. False OOS is a real inventory/app bug — we've sent it to the app and stock teams.

author: Pimnara Y.
body: สั่งได้แต่ของแห้ง ของสดสั่งไม่ได้ ควรปรับปรุง แอพอื่น เช่น 7-11, Lotus, Tops, Makro สั่งได้ทุกอย่าง ส่งทุกอย่าง แล้วใครจะใช้แอพ Villa
suggested_reply: ขออภัยที่สั่งได้แค่ของแห้ง ของสดสั่งไม่ได้ ทั้งที่ร้านอื่นส่งครบ เราทราบว่าแอปจำกัดบางหมวดและส่งต่อให้ทีมแอปกับทีมสต็อกแล้วค่ะ

author: Dakota
body: very low quality and performance app. everything else on my phone works perfectly fine but this app. don't download it!
suggested_reply: Sorry the app feels low quality and slow when everything else on your phone is fine. Performance on Android is a real complaint we're tracking — thanks for saying it plainly.

author: Nice Paul
body: After paying for the order, the goods still appear in the cart and the app shows ‘processing payment’ even after payment has gone through. I’ve brought this to the attention of their customer service maybe a dozen times but it never gets fixed. Extremely disappointing.
suggested_reply: We're sorry — a cart that still shows paid items and stays on 'processing payment' after you've paid (and after many CS reports) is unacceptable. Escalated to the payments/app team with your review attached.

author: Farang working in Thailand
body: Living in Bangkok and everyone told me to shop at Villa for western groceries. I thought, ok cool. Let’s try ordering delivery. Download the app. Doesn’t load. Open close open close. Finally opens. Select the location closest to me. Fill my cart. Asks to verify phone number. Put it in. Get messaged code. Doesn’t load. Try email. Doesn’t load. After multiple tries, finally works. Tries to check out, and then says wrong location even though this is the location closest to me. I switch the options available. Empties my cart! What a huge waste of time. I’ll try in person maybe in the future, but not any time soon.
suggested_reply: We're truly sorry for that first try: app wouldn't load, phone verify stalled, wrong-location errors, then the cart emptied when you changed store. Those are known bugs — your review is with the app team. In-app chat can help if you want to retry a first order.

author: John Foderaro
body: otp working again. I still would like fingerprint authorization rather than pin authorization
suggested_reply: Glad OTP is working again. Noted on fingerprint instead of PIN — we've passed the biometric-login request to the Android team.

author: greendaisy1
body: It keeps saying that my password is incorrect, so I clicked on Forget Password and entered my phone number and Continue. But nothing showed up, except when I clicked Continue three times, it said that I have exceeded the attempt limit. Useless and non-functional app. There is no customer service on LINE. Phone support also hangs up as soon as I say Hello. Very bad service overall.
suggested_reply: Sorry — wrong password loop, then Forget Password did nothing until you hit the attempt limit, plus no usable LINE/phone support. Password-reset and support gaps are both on us. Email ewallet@villamarket.com with your phone number if you need the account unlocked manually.

author: Orientix
body: Cannot log in. Apparently new app. They indicate to create new account using old tel number. Does not work. Cannot create. Also tried on website. Only many error messages. Sent email, they don’t reply.
suggested_reply: Sorry — migrating with your old phone number failed on both app and website, with error spam and no reply to your email. Account migration should have worked. Please email ewallet@villamarket.com with the registered number; the team can link the account manually.

author: Paid member
body: Cannot complete wallet setup because app freezes and crashes
suggested_reply: Sorry wallet setup freezes and crashes before you can finish — especially as a paid member. We've sent the wallet crash report to the iOS/payments team.
